title: Planet Jupiter
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 31 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Jupiter as guru and decision maker, the gut, the home temple, north-east, the peepal, aspects, sign 9 and when a topaz is not worn.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 31, Planet Jupiter by Brajesh Gautam: the guru, ego and greed, the belly, home temple and north-east rules, aspects, topaz cautions and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Jupiter is the guru and the decision maker.
The one who gives without wanting anything back, and the one who finally settles your matters.
The cow with a guru came out of the marsh. The lion with ego died in it.
Boasting and greed before a purchase spoil Jupiter, he says. Never take free goods.
Gas, sour belching and a heavy head show a disturbed Jupiter in his teaching. Settle the belly first.
North-east is Jupiter's place at home.
Keep it empty, clean and fragrant. No storage, kitchen, toilet, red or yellow.
He advises against a home temple.
Drains are Rahu and press Jupiter. Bells, metal idols and silver lamps are named.
Jupiter always gives, but on his terms.
Aspects fall on the 5th and 9th. Where he sits he lets no one else run.
Sign 9 is his home. Signs 10 and 11 in the wrong houses make a topaz unsuitable, per the speaker.
